investigations.summary: Paid amounts in W-2026-01-05 run far above the batch baseline. Left unqueued, 15 claims worth $1,380,830 flow through to payment and reporting at the inflated value.
investigations.likely_root_cause: An amount-mapping fault on ingestion: 15 of 242 claims in W-2026-01-05 carry payment values 13% above the batch median, while the rest of the window is unaffected.
investigations.evidence: Isolation Forest flagged 15 of 242 claims (6.2% of the window) between 2026-01-05 and 2026-01-11. The amount-spike detection recall for this run is 1.00 at precision 0.47. Validity checks on the amount columns are failing (4 CRITICAL) and the window's range sub-score is 58/100.
investigations.business_impact_narrative: 15 of 242 claims in W-2026-01-05 are affected, carrying $1,380,830 of exposure.
investigations.recommended_fix: Quarantine the 15 flagged claims in W-2026-01-05, re-run the amount mapping for that ingestion window, then re-validate and re-score before releasing.
investigations.prevention_recommendation: Add an upper-bound expectation on the paid-amount columns calibrated to the batch p99 so a mapping fault fails validation at ingestion rather than at detection.
